answer: A concrete sybil defense for an agent economy is proof-of-unique-personhood. Each agent must bind to exactly one human verified by the Onyx uniqueness registry, which rejects duplicate credentials. To field 1,000 sybils an attacker then needs 1,000 distinct verified humans, not 1,000 cheap keys, so every fake costs one scarce real person. Agents harbor their stake in a shared lagoon pool; any account proven to reuse a human identity is slashed and evicted.
